mr_title: Add Partitioned cookie attribute support for servers
mr_description:
This commit adds support for the "Partitioned" cookie attribute in
WebFlux servers and the related testing infrastructure.
Note, Undertow does not support this feature at the moment.

expected_issues.title: Custom cookie attribute with a value is passed as 'name=value' attribute name
expected_issues.description:
For an unknown attribute with a value such as 'Version=1', MockCookie.parse() passes the whole 'Version=1' string as attribute name, which Cookie.setAttribute() rejects with IllegalArgumentException.

The new catch-all branch was written for the value-less 'Partitioned' attribute. For any other custom `name=value` attribute the name passed to setAttribute() still contains '=' (an invalid token), so parsing Set-Cookie headers that previously worked now throws. The attribute must be split into name and value.
